decisions.timeUnit: National remaining-time field is preserved as a raw integer but timingQuality remains unverified and sourceUnit remains unknown because SA-01 did not prove the unit or source time semantics.
decisions.direction: Eight raw direction prefixes are retained as sourceDirectionCode and mapped only to internal straight approach keys; no operational road-direction approval is inferred.
decisions.requestSharing: Subscriptions are grouped by provider region request, so 1 and 100 subscribers for the same stdgCd share one origin request unit.
decisions.budget: No collection request is allowed without explicit daily and per-second budget. Retry attempts reserve budget like normal requests.
decisions.cache: Duplicate source events update lastSeenAtUtcMs only and do not extend expiresAtUtcMs. Older source events are ignored. Unknown ordering remains disabled for prediction.

scenarios: Recorded redacted national signal fixture normalizes to eight disabled observations without approving prediction timing.
K3 and K03 are empty results rather than fatal provider errors.
Provider auth messages redact serviceKey query values.
100 same-region subscribers produce one national request plan entry.
Unconfigured quota blocks collection; retry backoff is bounded; retries consume budget.
A -> A duplicate -> older B -> new C preserves A expiry, ignores B, accepts C.

notClosedReasons: SA-05 depends on SA-01 provider timing/unit/direction evidence and SA-04 runtime readiness, both still open.
No live operational collector is enabled because approved quota and timing semantics are not available.
The implemented normalizer is intentionally non-operational for predictions until provider evidence is supplied.
